correctness.rationale: Construct the graph as triangular-bipyramid Kleetope (11 vertices,27 edges). Independently enumerate all 1441 nonempty matchings with f=(27,219,613,510,72), rebuild certificate 14-stage toggles, check 662 nonempty matched pairs, acyclic orientation on all 1441 faces/4677 incidences, critical cells (1 in degree0,49 in degree2,67 in degree3). Reconstruct integral signed 49x67 Morse boundary, SHA-256 0042e255c0bdcc8db6e602d39eb8614f3d966ad89e8140c4462faa26aa299bf6 matching frozen certificate. Independently calculate Smith normal form: precisely nineteen nonzero invariant factors, ALL equal to 1. Since simply connected Morse CW has no 1-cells, integer degree attaching maps diagonalize and cancel 19 2/3-cell pairs, leaving 30 S2 and 48 S3. F2 checks alone would not establish the integral claim.
